lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in approximately four semi-regular horizontal rows forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light-colored pixels on the dorsal edge and shadowed pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12 high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial density concentrated towards the leading edge and the base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots that contrast with the organized grid structure of the lateral flank blobs.
